items.raw_excerpt: Several hundred Ceuta residents took to the streets again on Sunday to protest the mass influx of migrants into their city, which occurred last month and is still having an effect.
items.summary_en: Hundreds of residents in Ceuta, Spain held another protest against a large wave of migrants who entered their city last month. The demonstrations marked one month since the influx began. Locals say the event continues to affect their daily lives.

items.title_en: Ceuta residents protest one month after migrant surge

items.raw_excerpt: September is a historic turning point in Norway. For the first time in 35 years, the country starts a new month with a new monarch, along with several important changes and the arrival of autumn.
items.summary_en: Norway enters September 2026 with a historic change. For the first time in 35 years the country begins a month under a new monarch. Several everyday rules and routines also shift with the start of autumn.

items.title_en: September 2026: What changes in daily life in Norway

items.raw_excerpt: In the third round of 2026 referendums, to be held on September 27th, Swiss voters will have their say on a variety of issues of both national and cantonal importance.
items.summary_en: Several Swiss cantons will hold referendums on September 27th. Voters will decide on tax changes and assisted-dying rules that affect their local communities.

items.raw_excerpt: The bloc's patent office says the city in Finnish Lapland can keep its status as the "official hometown of Santa Claus."
items.summary_en: The European Union's patent office has ruled that Rovaniemi in Finnish Lapland can keep its title as the official hometown of Santa Claus. The city has long marketed itself as the home of Father Christmas. The ruling means only Rovaniemi can officially use the Santa Claus hometown branding.
items.summary_ko: EU 특허청은 핀란드 라플란드의 도시 로바니에미가 산타클로스의 공식 고향 지위를 계속 유지할 수 있다고 판결했습니다. 이 도시는 오랫동안 산타클로스의 고향으로 자신을 홍보해 왔습니다. 이번 판결로 로바니에미만이 산타클로스 고향 브랜딩을 공식적으로 사용할 수 있게 되었습니다.
items.title_en: EU Patent Office Rules Rovaniemi Is Santa's Official Hometown
items.title_ko: EU, 로바니에미를 산타클로스 공식 고향으로 인정

items.raw_excerpt: Parliamentary panel discusses Tamil Nadu's water resource planning, infrastructure, and challenges like groundwater depletion and water security.
items.summary_en: A parliamentary committee held a meeting to discuss Tamil Nadu's water resource planning and infrastructure. The panel reviewed challenges including groundwater depletion and water security in the state.

items.raw_excerpt: This week, we’re widening our scope and taking you beyond Reykjavík’s usual venues. In fact, plenty is happening in the neighbouring towns, so take a closer look at Kópavogur and Hafnarfjörður. From Hamraborg Festival, which celebrates the local artistic community, to a cosplay gathering, look a little further afield, and you’ll find Iceland’s satellite towns…
items.summary_en: Local events are happening in the small towns of Kópavogur and Hafnarfjörður near Reykjavík. The Hamraborg Festival celebrates the local artistic community, along with a cosplay gathering. These events showcase the vibrant cultural life in Iceland's satellite towns.

items.raw_excerpt: The person who becomes the 500 millionth renter of Taiwan's public bicycle-rental system, YouBike, in Taipei in the coming weeks will receive a shopping voucher for NT$20,000 (US$630), the Taipei City Department of Transportation said Monday.
items.summary_en: Taipei's public bicycle rental system YouBike is about to reach 500 million rentals. The lucky 500 millionth renter will receive a shopping voucher worth NT$20,000, about US$630. The Taipei City Department of Transportation announced this special prize to celebrate the milestone.
items.summary_ko: 대만 타이베이의 공공자전거 대여 시스템 YouBike가 곧 5억 번째 대여를 달성합니다. 행운의 5억 번째 이용자에게는 약 630달러 상당의 쇼핑 바우처가 주어집니다. 타이베이시 교통국은 이번 기념일을 축하하기 위해 특별 경품을 마련했습니다.
items.title_en: Taipei YouBike Celebrates 500 Million Rentals

items.raw_excerpt: Fancy a walk through remote moorland, a village called booze, and end it all with a delicious ale? We have got you covered. Explore today.
items.summary_en: This walking trail in North Yorkshire crosses wild moorland and passes through the quirky village of Booze. The village name is real and adds charm to the route. The trail ends at a cosy pub where you can enjoy a refreshing ale.
items.summary_ko: 북부 요크셔의 이 산책로는 황야를 가로지르며 흥미로운 부즈 마을을 지나간다. 실제로 존재하는 이 재미있는 이름의 마을은 산책에 재미를 더해준다. 산책은 상쾌한 에일을 마실 수 있는 아늑한 펍에서 끝난다.

items.raw_excerpt: Na encosta norte da Serra da Estrela, a aldeia de Sameiro guarda uma paisagem marcada pela montanha, pelo rio Zêzere…
items.summary_en: On the north slope of Serra da Estrela in Portugal, the village of Sameiro offers a river beach on the Zêzere River surrounded by mountains. Praia Fluvial da Relva da Reboleira has cold clear water, free parking, a campground, and hiking trails through the natural park. The village is known for its stone houses, legends, and a footbridge over the river.

items.summary_en: A homeless man in Edmonton is asking a judge to hold the city responsible for taking and throwing away his personal items during a camp cleanup. The man says city workers seized his belongings two years ago. He is now challenging the city's actions in court.
